title: Deep Size Measurement and a Leak Probe
instructions: In `leakprobe.py` implement `deep_sizeof(obj)`, an iterative, cycle-safe size estimate that counts each reachable object once and follows `__dict__` and `__slots__`, and `LeakProbe`, which tracks objects weakly and reports how many survive a forced `gc.collect()`.

evidence.label: Deep size of nested data is much larger than the shallow size
A shared object is counted once, so a second reference costs only a pointer
A slotted instance measures smaller than a dict-based one for the same data
Values stored in __slots__ are included in the total
Self-referential structures terminate and are counted once
The probe counts retained objects and sees released ones die
Follows slots declared on base classes and tolerates unassigned slots
Handles a 10,000-deep linked list without recursion
Does not walk into classes, builtins or functions reachable from the instance
track() returns the object and holds only a weak reference
